notes.title: Allllllmost there...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/39f93f78b4b28cc7efc894779ee8d3cf81f6c550.png[/img]

it's coming along! 
I have been tirelessly adding things to the hub world so it feels full of stuff to do. 
peppering in mini games and side quests.

[previewyoutube=ek6ZbTTxwjc;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/2b7da768ec8857eaded9988839c0e5b0ad9fe8ed.png[/img]

notes.title: Boosting the visuals
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ejuBIaCQoms;full][/previewyoutube]

I have been going over the whole hub world and all main levels to visually improve them, its been loads of work but I think it looks feels much nicer now. 

in the hub world you can find lost parts which you can use to upgrade your main weapon, repair Zip-Lines to get around the world faster and some other stuff. 
you will also come across Bowler Outposts which will often have region maps for your Steam-Dex! 
there are rail-ports which once liberated from bowler control can be used to fast travel around the realm.
there are also lots of NPCs and little secrets peppered all around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/e552b6b77609b964f4e6d0a120c80496e8faf6a5.png[/img]

[b]World regions :
Steamopolis
Western Plains 
Easter Plains
Lower Jungles
The Waterfall 
Burnlands
Horror Hollow 
Uplands
Roughrider Ridge 
The Grand Embankment 
Galvanic Elevation
Tumble Town Junction
Green Wood Gulch
[/b]
I have also been adding changes based on peoples feedback after playing the demo.
voices will be able to be turned off, I will also be getting voice acting done for some of the lines. 
I will still have to do some myself and change the tone via AI cause I am too poor to hire actors for the whole thing lol. but hopefully it will add a campy charm like in those classic mega man X cut scenes 
[previewyoutube=9OVv-J-LXQU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/2b5dd16630a1f6e11cca81bd24476e7d205ec368.png[/img]



The main weapon will start with a faster fire speed and bullet speed so it feels nicer right out the gate. 

I made the Dash last slightly longer and you can now jump up as you dash like in Mega Man X 

working on adding an option in the menu to switch controls right to Mega Man-ish style.

I am also considering going into early access so I can really fine tune things as a smaller number of people try it and start exploring, love to know other peoples thoughts on that.
Thanks everyone for playing and giving feedback! 

I will be trying to update the demo with all the new stuff soon as well.

Have a awesome day
-Ash 
Monster Robot Studios 
-Games For Humans-

notes.title: Steam Punks Demo now available!
notes.content:
[h1]HEADS UP for Steam Deck users If the game fails to open on SteamDeck[/h1]
[b]go to the gear icon > Properties > compatibility and set that to ON (enable proton) on SteamDeck.
this should fix it if it isn't launching. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/b47bb48c2be6f5c8e2b3360a8ce26f2a9af6047a.png[/img]

[h1]The Steamopolis Archives are under attack![/h1]
Take control of Dunns and thwart the Bowler Gangs rampage!

the Steampunks Demo offers a slice of what is in store with Steam Punks.
The full game will of course include 

[b]
*data saving, everything you find/collect will remain in your inventory in the final game 
*Steam Achievements 
*Foods and other healing pick-ups.
*tons of items and power ups
*more music/voices etc. 
*tons of alchemy bullets/recipes and lore stone data
*Steam dex will track enemies you defeat like in the demo, but also have other features, like each time you see a new object you can interact with it will log that and give you info on what items are needed to use it. 
*8 main stages + intro, midpoint and final stage along with sub-missions.
*Hub towns and many NPCs
*lots more! [/b]

Please try it out and comment in the community  or on my [url=https://x.com/MonsterRobotGC]twitter/X[/url] with any feedback/ideas you have or would like to see implemented into the final game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/da3909866c141065866a04f54019483b575db6b6.png[/img]

Thanks so much for the support
-Ash

notes.title: Steam Punks Prologue Part I : The Cataclysm
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nf3w_JLZneU;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/2b9e76690f7c854127f9c508af71b4ef9c57bdab.jpg[/img]




[h2][b]Steam Punks Prologue Part I : The Cataclysm[/b][/h2]

In the first age, the world was new, and both gods and men walked the realm together.
The gods taught the wisest of man about all things; these great men were known as the 8 Alchemy Mages. The gods helped guide them on how to harness the energy of the stars above and how to use their power and frequency.  Over time, they helped them construct the great Star Fortresses, massive strongholds that could channel the power of the celestial ley lines.These great structures supplied all the land with energy and tranquility. This was the age of harmony. The gods moved on from the realm and left men to pursue peace and prosperity, leaving behind only the LoreStones, mystical rocks that contained the wisdom and teachings of the gods.



But good and evil are as old as time itself, and in the second age of the realm, monsters from the "Depth" invaded the land. For centuries, battle ensued, but with the help of the Alchemy Mages, man was able to keep their place in this realm. The Alchemy Mages forged incredible weapons to help stave off the monsters, the most powerful of which was the HEAVY Sword. Wielded by Treadzar, the strongest man ever to live. With each monster he struck down, their dark spirit would be cast into Mayhem Mountain, locked away and unable to harm anyone.  However, as the multitudes of monster spirits within Mayhem Mountain grew, so did their power, and the 8 Alchemy mages soon realized the seal on the mountain that was meant to keep the vile creatures locked away might soon give way, and a plague of monstrous beasts would be unleashed on the realm once more. The Cataclysm So the Alchemy mages once again convened, and Thoth of the Northern Lands advised that they use the power of all the Star Fortresses at once to channel the ley line and celestial energies to fire upon Mayhem Mountain and destroy it and everything within it. The other mages demanded that this was not the answer, as the ancient Lore Stones told that celestial energies and frequencies are a tool of peace and should only be used to build and heal, never to destroy. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/c60f87454ba52adfb03f4a8b843cd63acfca9215.jpg[/img]


But Thoth visited the kings of the realm one by one and spread fear across all the kingdoms, so it was agreed that the Star Fortresses would be used to destroy Mayhem Mountain before the monsters could escape.  It was this event that triggered the cataclysm. The realm descended into violent earthquakes and massive tsunamis. When all was said and done, the entire land and everything that had ever been built was covered in layer upon layer of mud and muck. 
By the time the waters had receded, nearly all who lived in the realm were lost in the waves of mud. and all the knowledge, skills, and achievements of mankind were wiped away in a matter of minutes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954646/d54f420569ff705e00209463598ab88a798539fd.jpg[/img]



Thanks for reading/watching! feel free to post any questions or comments about the back story/lore 
and please be sure to wishlist Steam Punks if you haven't already 

[b]Part II will be coming shortly 
-Ash 
Monster Robot Studios 
-Games for Humans-[/b]

notes.title: The Alchemy Gun
notes.content:
all the levels and hub town are coming along. I have also been building out the Alchemy Shell Crafting system. you can discover hidden Alchemy Shell Recipes within levels & the hub world then collect or buy the supplies you need to craft powerful shells! in all there will be 25 shells. 
they will have different powers like freezing enemies, causing enemies and objects to float, etc. 

[previewyoutube=Gliguw7cXJY;full][/previewyoutube]

Along with that, you will also be able to find scrap parts for your main gun which will allow you to upgrade its fire power, bullet speed, reload speed and add a charge up. 
there will be lots to discover! and off course being bosses will unlock new items which you will be able to use throughout the game 
more updates coming soon! Thanks for reading! and if you haven't already, please be sure to wishlist and follow Steam Punks! tell yer friends, every wish list helps loads

if you have any questions or comments post below 
or send them to me on [url=https://x.com/MonsterRobotGC]Twitter/X[/url]
